name: QDevil (Quantum Machines Denmark)
description: QDevil is a Danish quantum technology company that develops and manufactures auxiliary electronics and specialized components critical for operating quantum processing units, from millikelvin to room temperature. Originally a spin-out from the Niels Bohr Institute at the University of Copenhagen, QDevil was acquired by Quantum Machines in 2022 and now operates as its Auxiliary Electronics Division from Copenhagen.

products.name: QDAC Digital-to-Analog Converters
products.description: Precision multi-channel digital-to-analog converters for quantum dot and superconducting qubit control

products.name: QFilter Cryogenic Filters
products.description: Ultra-low-noise cryogenic signal filtering components for millikelvin quantum experiments
